playing.answerLocked: Answer locked in — waiting for others...

artistPicker.title: Select Artists
artistPicker.description: Pick one or more artists. Songs are drawn from your selection.
artistPicker.empty: No artists available yet. Run the seed to load music.

buzzer.title: Buzzer Trivia
buzzer.description: Fast-paced trivia. Buzz in first, answer against the clock, win the points.

music.title: Music Quiz
music.description: Listen to a clip and pick the right song from three options. Answer fast and keep a streak to score big.

livebuzzer.title: Live Buzzer
livebuzzer.description: You read the questions out loud, the room races to buzz in. Winners are ranked by reaction time, not by who has the better Wi-Fi.

create.hostPlaysHint: Let the host join the buzzer race instead of only moderating.
create.buzzWindowHint: How long players have to buzz in. Off means you control the pace.
create.answerTimeHint: How long the locked-in player has to answer once buzzed. Off means no clock.
create.decreaseMaxWrong: Decrease max wrong buzzes per round
create.increaseMaxWrong: Increase max wrong buzzes per round
create.modeCloudHint: Players join from anywhere. Needs internet.
create.modeLocalHint: Your phone hosts the game. No internet needed.
create.modeLocalNote: Players on the same Wi-Fi scan a QR code and buzz in from their browser. Keep the app open while you play.

host.idleHint: Read the question aloud, then open the buzzer.
host.armedHint: Buzzer is open — first fair buzz wins.

endGameConfirm.title: End the game?
endGameConfirm.description: This finishes the match now and locks in final scores.
